explanation: Mathlib has `LocallyQuasiFinite.of_finite_preimage_singleton` and `LocallyQuasiFinite.of_fiberToSpecResidueField`, but neither states the criterion in this theorem: the former assumes finite ordinary point-preimages, while this theorem assumes finite sets of geometric-point morphisms. Turning the latter into the former requires the substantive fiber and topology argument shown in the proof. I also searched Mathlib’s algebraic-geometry sources for matching geometric-point fiber criteria and found no duplicate.
